findings.detail: Table \`public.workshop_capacity_receipts\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

Function `public.get_workshop_capacity_configuration(p_stage_code text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/get_workshop_capacity_configuration`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.replan_workshop_capacity(p_stage_code text, p_bay_number integer, p_efficiency_percent integer, p_apply boolean, p_expected_plan_hash text, p_idempotency_key uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/replan_workshop_capacity`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
